archetypes.name: dyn-corpus-metrics
archetypes.rationale: Reference-read accounting depends on safe corpus denominators and per-run token math.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the run_log_corpus helper and report/tokens measurement changes. Check that manifest-less, issue-less, symlinked, and transcript-missing runs affect reads, runs_observed, and realized tokens exactly as intended. Pay special attention to duplicate Read events and shared-reference token caching. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-design-capture
archetypes.rationale: Design publish now captures and hoists transcripts before log publish.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review design_publish transcript capture integration. Verify stale root cleanup is mandatory, snapshot materialization uses source-env SESSION_ID rather than session-env.sh, capture skip paths publish without stale transcripts, and capture-success hoist failures abort before log-publish. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-transcript-sanitize
archetypes.rationale: Renderer now preserves a narrow class of tool invocations in committed transcripts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review render_session_transcript sanitized Read preservation. Confirm only Read calls for skills/**/references/*.md and skills/shared/*.md are emitted, with only type/name/input.file_path, and that absolute, cache, and redacted path normalization cannot leak local paths or non-reference file names. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
